description: This file defines the 'Result' class, which models the outcome of logic evaluations within the OpenMRS medical record system. It encapsulates various data types (boolean, coded concepts, date/time, numeric, text), supports storing multiple results as a list, and provides methods for converting, comparing, and manipulating these results.

classes.name: Result
classes.description: Represents a single or multiple logic evaluation results, supporting various data types, comparisons, conversions, and list operations.

methods.name: emptyResult
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance representing an empty result.

methods.name: getDatatype
methods.description: Returns the datatype of the result or the first element if the result is a list.

methods.name: setResultDate
methods.description: Sets the timestamp associated with the result, typically the observation recording date.

methods.name: setDatatype
methods.description: Overrides the default datatype of the result.

methods.name: setValueBoolean
methods.description: Overrides the boolean value of the result.

methods.name: setValueCoded
methods.description: Overrides the coded concept value of the result.

methods.name: setValueDatetime
methods.description: Overrides the datetime value of the result.

methods.name: setValueNumeric
methods.description: Overrides the numeric value of the result with a Double.

methods.name: setValueText
methods.description: Overrides the text value of the result.

methods.name: toBoolean
methods.description: Converts the result to a boolean based on its datatype and values.

methods.name: toConcept
methods.description: Returns the concept associated with the result if available.

methods.name: toDatetime
methods.description: Returns the datetime value of the result, attempting to parse from text if necessary.

methods.name: toNumber
methods.description: Returns a numeric representation of the result based on its datatype.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation for the result or list of results.

methods.name: toObject
methods.description: Returns the underlying object associated with the result.

methods.name: isNull
methods.description: Indicates if the result is null or empty.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks whether the result has any meaningful value.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if the result contains a specific concept or result.

methods.name: unique
methods.description: Removes duplicate results from a list.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another result, considering list and single result types.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code for the result, based on its datatype and content.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific member of a result list, or the result itself if not a list.

methods.name: earliest
methods.description: Returns the chronologically earliest result in a list.

methods.name: latest
methods.description: Returns the chronologically latest result in a list.
